releases.summary: Install the signed Windows connector once on the printing computer, then the MSCQR Connector starts automatically in the background.
notes: Use the signed Windows installer on the Windows PC that is connected to the printer.
This connector advertises local-agent-direct-v2 and is compatible with the current direct-print backend.
Windows installation verifies local printer readiness before claiming success and opens Printer Setup automatically when attention is still needed.
Windows should show L&D Health Ltd as the verified publisher for this installer.
